summary: usb-storage is blocked on node1 now and after reboot. The module stayed unloaded, explicit load attempts failed, and node1 recovered normally after restart with a changed boot ID.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with blacklist and install /bin/false rules.
Removed usb-storage if loaded; it was already absent.
Added early-boot blacklist kernel arguments and excluded usb-storage from the initramfs.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified recovery.

evidence.summary: The effective rule resolves to /bin/false; an explicit modprobe exited 1 and usb_storage remained unloaded.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: Persistent modprobe policy, boot blacklist arguments, and initramfs exclusion are active. After reboot, usb_storage was absent and a load attempt still failed.

Baseline boot ID was 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID was fdefef07-b3ce-413d-a1d2-6f29ec027fdb. System state returned to running and blacklist enforcement remained healthy.
